{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-run the initial inspection to ensure we have full visibility on 'responded'
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Explicitly check for missing values in 'responded'
missing_responded = df['responded'].isnull().sum()

# Check the full set of unique values in 'responded'
unique_responded = df['responded'].unique()

print(f"Missing values in 'responded': {missing_responded}")
print(f"Unique values in 'responded': {unique_responded}")"}
